title: Sortie
core_verb: Destroy enemy aircraft with the fighter's guns and missiles.
fantasy: A modern fighter pilot conducts a single combat sortie against a finite enemy formation and boss aircraft in a bounded airspace above solid terrain.
fail_state: The aircraft's health reaches zero, the aircraft collides with terrain and crashes, or the sortie timer expires.
win_state: Every aircraft in the formation, including the boss aircraft, is destroyed and the target count reaches zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: Hostile formation aircraft that can attack the player and must be destroyed.
Solid ground hazard; colliding with it causes the player's aircraft to crash.
Final goal aircraft; destroying it as part of the finite target set contributes to reaching the zero-target victory state.

notes: A single-player campaign sortie is reduced to one bounded flight-combat encounter against scripted enemy aircraft and one boss. There is no campaign progression, score requirement, or endless wave loop.

scene.description: High-altitude open airspace above a brown-green terrain patchwork, the sun low on the horizon casting long shadows on the ground far below. An enemy formation spread waits ahead as a cluster of dark specks, a boss aircraft behind it, and the terrain floor bounds the volume from underneath. Contrails, cloud layers and runway markings far below are all that fill the space: sparse and wide open.
